name: O-Glycoside
note: A sugar is connected at its anomeric carbon through oxygen. Glycoside describes a linkage or compound class, not a single atom group.
noteKo: 당의 anomeric 탄소가 산소를 통해 연결된다. Glycoside는 단일 원자 작용기보다 결합 또는 화합물 계열을 뜻한다.

name: Alcohol
note: A hydroxyl on a saturated carbon. An alcohol is distinct from a phenol or a carboxylic-acid OH.
noteKo: 포화 탄소에 붙은 hydroxyl이다. Phenol이나 carboxylic acid의 OH와 구분한다.

name: Ketone
note: A carbonyl carbon bonded to two carbon groups: R–C(=O)–R.
noteKo: 탄소기 2개에 연결된 카보닐 탄소: R–C(=O)–R.

name: Aldehyde
note: A carbonyl carbon bearing a hydrogen: R–CHO.
noteKo: 수소가 붙은 카보닐 탄소: R–CHO.

name: Carboxylic acid
note: The carbonyl and hydroxyl belong to the same carbon: R–C(=O)–OH.
noteKo: 같은 탄소에 carbonyl과 hydroxyl이 연결된다: R–C(=O)–OH.

name: Ester
note: An acyl group connected through oxygen: R–C(=O)–O–R. Acetates are esters.
noteKo: 산소를 통해 연결된 acyl기: R–C(=O)–O–R. Acetate도 ester이다.

name: Lactone
note: A cyclic ester: both the carbonyl carbon and ester oxygen are in the ring.
noteKo: 고리형 ester이다. 카보닐 탄소와 ester 산소가 모두 고리에 포함된다.

name: Epoxide
note: A three-membered cyclic ether. A ring oxygen alone does not establish an epoxide.
noteKo: 3원환 cyclic ether이다. 고리에 산소가 있다는 것만으로 epoxide는 아니다.

name: Ether
note: An oxygen linking two carbon groups, without an adjacent carbonyl.
noteKo: 인접 carbonyl 없이 탄소기 2개를 잇는 산소이다.

name: Furan
note: A five-membered aromatic oxygen heterocycle. Furan is a ring motif, not a lactone.
noteKo: 산소를 포함하는 방향족 5원환이다. Furan은 고리 모티프이며 lactone과 구분된다.

name: Peroxide
note: An O–O bond. Artemisinin contains an endoperoxide within a ring system.
noteKo: O–O 결합이다. Artemisinin에는 고리 내부 endoperoxide가 존재한다.

name: Acetate ester
note: An ester whose acyl portion is acetyl: R–O–C(=O)–CH3. This is more specific than ester.
noteKo: Acyl 부분이 acetyl인 ester: R–O–C(=O)–CH3. Ester보다 구체적인 분류이다.

name: Alkene
note: A carbon–carbon double bond. Isolated alkenes, conjugated dienes and allenes have different connectivity; choose the most specific highlighted motif.
noteKo: A carbon–carbon double bond. Isolated alkenes, conjugated dienes and allenes have different connectivity; choose the most specific highlighted motif.

name: Exocyclic alkene
note: One alkene carbon belongs to a ring and the other lies outside it. CPP and ent-kaurene illustrate exocyclic methylene groups.
noteKo: One alkene carbon belongs to a ring and the other lies outside it. CPP and ent-kaurene illustrate exocyclic methylene groups.

name: Conjugated diene
note: Two C=C bonds separated by one single bond. Carotenoid polyenes extend this conjugated pattern.
noteKo: Two C=C bonds separated by one single bond. Carotenoid polyenes extend this conjugated pattern.

name: Allene
note: Cumulated C=C=C bonds share the central carbon. Fucoxanthin and neoxanthin contain an allenic unit; this differs from a conjugated diene.
noteKo: Cumulated C=C=C bonds share the central carbon. Fucoxanthin and neoxanthin contain an allenic unit; this differs from a conjugated diene.

name: Alkyne
note: A carbon–carbon triple bond. Diadinoxanthin provides an acetylenic xanthophyll example.
noteKo: A carbon–carbon triple bond. Diadinoxanthin provides an acetylenic xanthophyll example.

name: Phenol
note: An OH directly attached to an aromatic carbon. Phenolic monoterpenoids include thymol and carvacrol.
noteKo: An OH directly attached to an aromatic carbon. Phenolic monoterpenoids include thymol and carvacrol.

name: Enone
note: An alpha,beta-unsaturated ketone: the carbonyl is conjugated with C=C. This is more specific than ketone or alkene.
noteKo: An alpha,beta-unsaturated ketone: the carbonyl is conjugated with C=C. This is more specific than ketone or alkene.

name: Quinone
note: A cyclic conjugated diketone motif, represented by a para-quinone model. Quinonoid diterpenoids include several tanshinones.
noteKo: A cyclic conjugated diketone motif, represented by a para-quinone model. Quinonoid diterpenoids include several tanshinones.

name: Hemiacetal
note: The same carbon bears OH, OR, H and a carbon substituent. It differs from a hemiketal, which has two carbon substituents.
noteKo: The same carbon bears OH, OR, H and a carbon substituent. It differs from a hemiketal, which has two carbon substituents.

name: Hemiketal
note: One tetrahedral carbon bears OH, OR and two carbon substituents. This is the ketone-derived analogue of a hemiacetal.
noteKo: One tetrahedral carbon bears OH, OR and two carbon substituents. This is the ketone-derived analogue of a hemiacetal.

name: Acetal
note: A tetrahedral carbon bonded to two OR groups, H and carbon. Acetal is also used as the broader class including ketals.
noteKo: A tetrahedral carbon bonded to two OR groups, H and carbon. Acetal is also used as the broader class including ketals.

name: Ketal
note: A ketone-derived acetal: one carbon bears two OR groups and two carbon substituents. This is the more specific label for this model.
noteKo: A ketone-derived acetal: one carbon bears two OR groups and two carbon substituents. This is the more specific label for this model.

name: Lactol
note: A cyclic hemiacetal. An OH-bearing carbon is bonded to a ring oxygen; a lactone instead has a carbonyl at this position.
noteKo: A cyclic hemiacetal. An OH-bearing carbon is bonded to a ring oxygen; a lactone instead has a carbonyl at this position.

name: Amide
note: A carbonyl carbon directly bonded to nitrogen. Paclitaxel contains an amide in its side chain.
noteKo: A carbonyl carbon directly bonded to nitrogen. Paclitaxel contains an amide in its side chain.

name: Amine
note: An amine nitrogen without an adjacent acyl carbonyl. Nitrogen-containing diterpenoid alkaloids illustrate this broader chemistry.
noteKo: An amine nitrogen without an adjacent acyl carbonyl. Nitrogen-containing diterpenoid alkaloids illustrate this broader chemistry.

name: Methyl ester
note: The ester alcohol-derived portion is methyl: R-C(=O)-O-CH3. This differs from an acetate, where the acyl portion is CH3-C(=O)-.
noteKo: The ester alcohol-derived portion is methyl: R-C(=O)-O-CH3. This differs from an acetate, where the acyl portion is CH3-C(=O)-.

name: Methoxy group
note: An O-CH3 substituent represented as a methyl ether. This model has no adjacent carbonyl, unlike a methyl ester.
noteKo: An O-CH3 substituent represented as a methyl ether. This model has no adjacent carbonyl, unlike a methyl ester.

name: Hydroperoxide
note: An R-O-O-H group. It differs from the R-O-O-R peroxide model and a cyclic endoperoxide.
noteKo: An R-O-O-H group. It differs from the R-O-O-R peroxide model and a cyclic endoperoxide.

name: Phosphate ester
note: An organic O-phosphate linkage. This model shows one phosphate, rather than a diphosphate with a P-O-P bond.
noteKo: An organic O-phosphate linkage. This model shows one phosphate, rather than a diphosphate with a P-O-P bond.

name: Diphosphate
note: Two phosphate units joined by P-O-P. IPP, DMAPP, GPP, FPP, GGPP and cyclized diterpene precursors carry this motif; protonation varies with pH.
noteKo: Two phosphate units joined by P-O-P. IPP, DMAPP, GPP, FPP, GGPP and cyclized diterpene precursors carry this motif; protonation varies with pH.

name: Sulfate ester
note: An organic O-sulfate: R-O-S(=O)2-OH in this protonation model. Sulfated terpenoid metabolites are distinct from sulfones.
noteKo: An organic O-sulfate: R-O-S(=O)2-OH in this protonation model. Sulfated terpenoid metabolites are distinct from sulfones.

name: Aromatic carbocycle
note: A benzene-like aromatic carbon ring. Some abietane diterpenoids acquire aromatic rings during oxidative tailoring.
noteKo: A benzene-like aromatic carbon ring. Some abietane diterpenoids acquire aromatic rings during oxidative tailoring.

name: Glycosyl ester
note: An acyl group is linked through oxygen to a sugar anomeric carbon. It is both a glycosidic derivative and an ester; UGTs can catalyse this linkage, so an ester does not establish ACT activity.
noteKo: An acyl group is linked through oxygen to a sugar anomeric carbon. It is both a glycosidic derivative and an ester; UGTs can catalyse this linkage, so an ester does not establish ACT activity.

name: Conjugated polyene
note: A generic four-double-bond conjugated chain. Carotenoids have extended alternating C=C and C-C systems; this motif is more extensive than the existing conjugated diene. Conjugation length and E/Z configuration are distinct descriptors.
noteKo: 일반적인 공액 이중결합 4개 모델입니다. Conjugation 길이와 E/Z 배치는 서로 다른 특징입니다.

name: α,β-Unsaturated γ-lactone
note: A generic α,β-unsaturated five-membered cyclic ester (butenolide) model. The C=C bond is conjugated to the lactone carbonyl. It is both a lactone and a conjugated ester, not an aromatic furan. This does not imply that every lactone is unsaturated.
noteKo: 이중결합이 carbonyl과 공액된 5원 불포화 cyclic ester 모델입니다. Furan과 구분되며 모든 lactone이 이 형태라는 뜻은 아닙니다.
